name: euler
description: A provider-agnostic coding agent for the terminal.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.tsx --format esm --platform node --target node22 --clean --out-dir dist && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.test: tsx --test src/tests/model-capabilities.test.ts src/tests/variant-translators.test.ts src/tests/model-service.test.ts src/tests/catalog.test.ts src/tests/fuzzy.test.ts src/tests/qwen-bridge.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build
